rules: Edit ONLY the plain text fields. Keys starting with _ are context and are ignored.
Plain text only: no HTML, no markdown, no ** or [] markup. Highlighting is automatic.
Keep ALL-CAPS keywords, dice notation (D3, D6, 2D6, D6+3) and quotes/inches as written.
armyRules text is a list: one entry per paragraph.
Leave a field unchanged if you have not done it yet. Never delete a key.

rule.text: In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one objective. That objective is your vowed objective until your next Command phase. ■ Friendly DEATHWING INFANTRY unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have +1 to wound rolls. Restrictions: Your army can include DARK ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

wrath_of_the_lion.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly DEATHWING unit ends a charge move.
wrath_of_the_lion.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: ■ For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

duty_unto_death.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly DEATHWING unit.
duty_unto_death.effect: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is engaged with an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective: ■ On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

relic_teleportarium.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly DEATHWING unit with the Deep Strike ability is selected to make an ingress move.
relic_teleportarium.effect: ■ Your unit can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"). ■ Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of this turn.

singular_will.text: DEATHWING model only. When this unit is selected to make a consolidation move, this unit can move up to D3+3".

champion_of_the_deathwing.text: DEATHWING model only. This unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rule.text: Attacks that target friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED units with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls. Restrictions: Your army can include DARK ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

in_sacrifice_victory.when: Any phase, when a friendly DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit within range of an objective is destroyed.
in_sacrifice_victory.target: That DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is destroyed.
in_sacrifice_victory.effect: Select one objective: ■ That no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) are within range of. ■ That your unit was controlling at the end of the previous phase. That objective is secured.

lions_will.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.
lions_will.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

inescapable_justice.when: The Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

tactical_mastery.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

knights_of_iron.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly RAVENWING unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

relics_of_the_dark_age.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to shoot.

deathwing_assault.text: DEATHWING model with the Deep Strike ability only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.
